references.text: Moses originally commanded that the blessing be proclaimed from Mount Gerizim and the curse from Mount Ebal.
Detailed instructions from Moses on which tribes should stand on Mount Gerizim to bless the people, and which should stand on Mount Ebal.
Moses wrote down this law and gave it to the priests, the sons of Levi, who carried the ark of the Lord's covenant.
The Levites who carried the ark of the Lord's covenant were instructed to place the book of the law beside the ark.
The Levitical priests carried the ark of the Lord's covenant when Israel crossed the Jordan.
The immediate context where Joshua built an altar on Mount Ebal and wrote a copy of the Law of Moses on stones.
The continuation where Joshua read aloud all the words of the law, the blessing and the curse, to the entire assembly of Israel.
